title: ContactServiceQueueBulkExportDTO
description: DTO for bulk export of Contact Service Queue data.

name.description: Name of the Contact Service Queue.

description.description: A short description of the queue.

type.description: The queue type, such as INBOUND or OUTBOUND.

channelType.description: The channel type of the queue.

routingType.description: The routing type for this queue.

recordingAllCallsPermitted.description: Indicates whether recording all calls is permitted.

pauseRecordingPermitted.description: Indicates whether pausing the recording is permitted.

recordingPauseDuration.description: The duration in seconds of pause in recording.

maxTimeInQueue.description: The time in seconds after which the queued request is distributed to the overflow number.

defaultMusicInQueueMediaFile.description: The default audio file played for calls when they arrive or are waiting in queue.

serviceLevelThreshold.description: The time in seconds before the system flags a request as outside the service level.

timezone.description: The time zone used by routing strategies for this queue.

imiOrgType.description: The IMI organization type associated with this queue.

skillBasedRoutingType.description: The skill-based routing type for this queue.

outdialCampaignEnabled.description: Indicates whether outdial campaign is enabled.

callDistributionGroups.description: The call distribution groups configured for this queue.

queueSkillRequirements.description: The skill requirements configured for this queue.

agents.description: The list of agent IDs assigned to this queue.

manuallyAssignable.description: Indicates whether the queue can be manually assigned.

queueLevelSentimentAnalysisInclusion.description: Queue level sentiment analysis inclusion type.

queueLevelPredictedWaitTimeInclusion.description: Queue level predicted wait time inclusion type.

queueLevelAutoCsatInclusion.description: Queue level auto CSAT inclusion type.

queueLevelRealTimeTranscriptionsInclusio.description: Queue level real time transcriptions inclusion type.

assistantSkill.description: The assistant skill mapping for this queue.
